title: device-ingest-incident
blurb: One malformed telemetry event restarts the worker forever while healthy device traffic piles up behind it.
brief:
At 02:17 UTC the telemetry worker entered a restart loop. Queue lag is climbing, and the same event ID appears immediately before every crash.

Start with `logs/worker.log`, `runbook.md`, and `fixtures/incident.ndjson`. Then reproduce the incident in the existing worker. Permanent data errors must be quarantined with a stable reason; unexpected infrastructure or programming failures must still surface.

**Your job:** isolate failure to one event, drain healthy traffic in order, and preserve exactly-once device updates.
